limitations: Manufacturer cover STL plus exact-SKU populated PCB STEP; model fidelity does not establish firmware support.
No physical hardware measurements; cover assembly translation and photographic alignment are not manufacturing tolerances.
Back PCB silk and pad appearance use the exact SKU official photo; holes, sidewalls, USB, battery socket and BTB remain real CAD geometry.
The retained cover is 17.7556x29.6240x5.5mm; it is not scaled to the official 18x29.8mm whole-product dimensions.
S015 has no soldered DIP headers; it is distinct from S015-DIP.
Native CAD display colors and photograph-based PCB/cover colors are appearance approximations; no calibrated optical or electrical material claim.

The separate front FPC carrier/tail is photo/video-supported simplified geometry; flex thickness/bend and visible RF-shield exact geometry are not supplied by CAD and remain unverified. No hidden traces, screws or standoffs are invented.

Official disassembly shows the real paper bridging the internal cover release relief below the FPC. This small documented internal bridge remains; no invented plastic fills the native hole. External paper edges are masked to the actual recess.
plan.assemblyNotes: Original cover STL retains the historical rigid y=-0.01585mm transform. Native populated PCB STEP uses additional translation [0,+0.91585,-1.75]mm: board component plane aligns with cover seating Z=-1.75mm; 28mm PCB body is centred +0.9mm within the documented 29.8mm USB-inclusive envelope. No scaling; full native STEP topology retained including USB open shells. This assembly alignment is checked against independent front/back/USB photos and not represented as a manufacturing measurement.

buttons.notes: Invisible hit region on molded PWR tab. Matches catalog power input; runtime polling only, no physical power/reset lifecycle claim.

derivedParts.notes: Separate printed paper follows central recess atZ2.55 plus0.015mm; explicit U-shaped source ROI avoids moldedM5, metal USB and shell rails. Photo boundary +/-0.3mm.

unknowns.label: Pinned default firmware artifact
unknowns.notes: No pinned binary/layout/hash verified. Software documentation remains linked in source records.

facts.label: Paper and optical face isolation
facts.value: Only manually selected original photograph paper/glass ROIs are retained. All molded shell areas, screws, ports, keys and live displays are excluded from photograph projection.
facts.method: Fixed original-pixel masks and independent mm planes; source images are unmodified except alpha and crop. Recess plane selected from manufacturer CAD planar-face audit.
facts.uncertainty: Paper boundary +/-0.3mm; optical cover diameter +/-0.5mm. Printed-paper images do not establish calibrated optics or firmware output.

facts.label: Manufacturer populated PCB assembly
facts.value: 384 native STEP components/shells, including true 18x28x1mm PCB, USB-C, SH1.0 battery socket and BTB; replaces cover-only UNKNOWN board.
facts.method: Hash-checked KiCad embedded STEP extraction; all native topology retained without scale; independent cover/board assembly transform documented.

facts.label: Front paper support
facts.value: Official disassembly reveals a separate black FPC antenna under the paper; it deliberately covers cover relief holes. Paper rests on FPC and the adjacent molded seat at Z2.55mm.
facts.uncertainty: FPC planar outline +/-0.3mm;0.2mm thickness inferred from cover recess, bend and hidden copper path unknown.
facts.method: Official disassembly9.8-12s and24.5s identifies separate FPC; native STL recess planes constrain the unscaled planar carrier and fixed photo mask.

front.basis: Independent official silhouette sets camera scale/center only; source geometry unchanged.

back.basis: Independent official silhouette sets camera scale/center only; source geometry unchanged.

side.notes: USB edge photo camera, independent18mm PCB width. Same scale/no geometry stretch; qualitative because camera perspective and lighting are uncalibrated.

textureSources.notes: Official printed cover label; no display pixels.
